Operations.Name: PoolSnapshotGetInstance
Operations.Description:
Returns instance matching `id`. If `id` is not found, Validation error is raised.

Please see `query` method documentation for `options`.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: Query options customize the results returned by a query method. More complete documentation with examples     are covered in the "Query methods" section of the TrueNAS API documentation.

Operations.Name: PoolSnapshotHold
Operations.Description:
Hold snapshot `id`.

Add `truenas` tag to the snapshot's tag namespace.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the snapshot to hold.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: Options for controlling snapshot hold behavior.

Operations.Name: PoolSnapshotQuery
Operations.Description:
Query all ZFS Snapshots with `query-filters` and `query-options`.

`query-options.extra.holds` *(bool)*
    Include hold tags for snapshots in the query result (false by default).
`query-options.extra.min_txg` *(int)*
    Limit snapshot retrieval based on minimum transaction group.
`query-options.extra.max_txg` *(int)*
    Limit snapshot retrieval based on maximum transaction group.
`query-options.extra.retention` *(bool)*
    Include retention information in the query result (false by default).
`query-options.extra.properties` *(dict)*
    Passed to `zfs.snapshots_serialized.props`.

Arguments.Name: filters
Arguments.Description: List of filters for query results. See API documentation for "Query Methods" for more guidance.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: Query options including pagination, ordering, and additional parameters.

Operations.Name: PoolSnapshotRelease
Operations.Description:
Release hold on snapshot `id`.

Remove all hold tags from the specified snapshot.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the held snapshot to release.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: Options for controlling snapshot release behavior.

Operations.Name: PoolSnapshotRename
Operations.Description:
Rename a snapshot `id` to `new_name`.

No safety checks are performed when renaming ZFS resources. If the dataset is in use by services such
as SMB, iSCSI, snapshot tasks, replication, or cloud sync, renaming may cause disruptions or service failures.

Proceed only if you are certain the ZFS resource is not in use and fully understand the risks.
Set Force to continue.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: Current ID of the snapshot to rename.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: The rename operation options including the new name and force flag.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the snapshot to rollback to.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: Options for controlling snapshot rollback behavior.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the snapshot to update.

Arguments.Name: data
Arguments.Description: The property updates to apply to the snapshot.

Fields.Description: Force unmount of any clones.

Fields.Description: Just like `recursive`, but also destroy any clones.

Fields.Description: Do a complete recursive rollback of each child snapshot for `id`. If any child does not have specified     snapshot, this operation will fail.
